notes.title: We have reached over 1500 requests and for that we would like to thank you very
notes.notes: [p][b]Thank You.[/b][/p][p]Despite the mistakes we made early in development, we are incredibly grateful to everyone who stood by us, supported us with feedback, and showed understanding. Every comment, every suggestion you shared has been truly valuable to us.[/p][p]Reaching 1,500 wishlists is a huge milestone for us — and we know this happened entirely thanks to you. You believed in us even when things weren’t perfect, and for that, we have deep respect and appreciation.[/p][p]As a small team of just two people, your trust means everything to us. We’ll continue doing our best to make sure we live up to it.[/p][p]— Lunart Team[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update for players requests
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Players,[/b][/p][p]First of all, we want to sincerely apologize.[/p][p]We’re aware that some players had a frustrating experience during the early stages of our game. We're truly sorry for that. We're a small team of just two people at Lunart Team, doing our best to create something meaningful — but there were moments where we fell short, and we take full responsibility for it.[/p][p]We’re carefully listening to all your feedback and working hard to improve the game. We’re learning from our mistakes and making steady progress to provide a better experience for everyone.[/p][p]Your support and patience mean a lot to us. notes.title: Wholesaler Simulator Steam Next Fest: Coming in June 2025
notes.notes:
[b][h1]What's in this game[/h1][/b]

We will build a warehouse from scratch and do wholesale business. You will work to become the king of the economy in this game based on bargaining, stocking, delivering products by vehicle and growing.


[b][h1]Don't forget to add to wishlist[/h1][/b]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390420/Wholesaler_Simulator/?curator_clanid=45548008


[b][h1]See you at Steam Next Fest in June[/h1][/b]

You will be able to play our demo that will be released in June for free. Your experiences are very important to us. If you download the demo and comment, you will contribute to the game. You can follow our steam page until the demo is released and be informed about the developments.
